supersedes: ADJUDICATION.md round-6 amendment (public-cause requirement), which conflated anomaly validity with explanation

anomaly.question: Is the session's daily change in this series unusual against an independently specified reference distribution?
anomaly.rule: YES if |change| of the item's session (official treasury.gov par yield, bp; 2s10s spread for the curve) is at or above the 97.5th percentile of |daily change| over the 250 preceding sessions of the same series in the same official CSVs; NO otherwise; UNASSESSABLE if fewer than 250 prior sessions or the official value is missing.
anomaly.notTheDetectorRule: This is an empirical 250-session percentile, not the detector's 60-session robust-scale / 8bp cutoff, and reviewers do not see detector output.

integrity.question: Do the tool's evidence values, session date and availability time match the official record?
integrity.rule: VALUE_ERROR: shown value differs from the official CSV by >0.5bp. TIMESTAMP_ERROR: wrong session date or a time earlier than publication (~18:00 ET). AVAILABILITY_ERROR: claimed available before it could be known. OK otherwise.

context.question: Is there an explanation? Recorded separately; it never changes the primary label.
context.rule: SCHEDULED: a release in release-calendar.json on the session (FOMC, CPI, NFP) or a scheduled auction. DOCUMENTED_UNSCHEDULED: contemporaneous official or major-wire record of an unscheduled event. UNEXPLAINED: searched, none found. UNAVAILABLE: could not search.

contextLabel: the context axis value, reported alongside, never combined into the primary label
reporting: Per stratum: share of ANOMALY_CONFIRMED / NOT_ANOMALOUS / FALSE among assessable items with Wilson 95% intervals; probability-sample estimates weighted by 1/inclusionProbability; Cohen's kappa on the primary label before adjudication; context distribution separately.
doNotReport: any figure with fewer than 100 assessable episodes
